Package net.chaossquad.mclib.advancedgui

Klasse AdvancedGUIUtils

java.lang.Object
net.chaossquad.mclib.advancedgui.AdvancedGUIUtils
public final class AdvancedGUIUtils extends Object
Utilities for the AdvancedGUI plugin. Requires that the AdvancedGUI plugin is installed.

    • setInteractionComponentTree

      public static boolean setInteractionComponentTree(@NotNull @NotNull me.leoko.advancedgui.utils.interactions.Interaction target, @NotNull @NotNull me.leoko.advancedgui.utils.components.GroupComponent componentTree)
      Replaces the component tree of an Interaction with a copy the specified GroupComponent. For safety reasons, this method will clone the specified component tree and set the interaction of the component tree to the target interaction.
      Parameter:
      target - target Interaction
      componentTree - GroupComponent to set
      Gibt zurück:
      success

    • canWallGuiBeInteractPhysically

      public static boolean canWallGuiBeInteractPhysically(@NotNull @NotNull me.leoko.advancedgui.utils.GuiWallInstance instance, @NotNull @NotNull me.leoko.advancedgui.utils.GuiPoint point, @NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player player, boolean checkForBlocks)
      Checks if the player can interact with the gui. It uses the vanilla interaction radius for that.
      This is necessary because AdvancedGUI does not check if a player is near enough to interact with the gui.
      Parameter:
      instance - gui instance the player has interacted with
      point - the point where the player has clicked
      player - the player that has interacted
      checkForBlocks - if this method should do a raytrace to check if blocks are between the player and the gui
      Gibt zurück:
      true = player can interact
